description: The Act metadata describes a greenhouse-gas limit of 100 megatonnes for oil-sands sites. It states exclusions for new upgraders or increased capacity at existing upgraders up to a combined maximum of 10 megatonnes, and for emissions attributable to the electricity portion of cogeneration. It also identifies authority to make implementing regulations. These are source-stated constraints for energy-production and upgrading facilities. They are not measured emissions or a verified statement of current law. The legal-publication URI does not establish a file format, edition, effective period or detailed calculation rules. Geographic coverage is Alberta. The Canadian Urban Data Catalogue preserves the source identifiers and descriptive metadata. The native licence is Alberta King's Printer Terms of Use.
